facts.statement: Shuangmiaosaurus is classified as a herbivorous iguanodontian ornithopod dinosaur.
facts.quote: Shuangmiaosaurus is a genus of herbivorous iguanodontian ornithopod dinosaur

facts.statement: The species Shuangmiaosaurus gilmorei was named and described by You Hailu, Ji Qiang Li Jinglu, and Li Yinxian in 2003.
facts.quote: The type species, Shuangmiaosaurus gilmorei, was named and described by You Hailu, Ji Qiang Li Jinglu and Li Yinxian in 2003

facts.statement: The genus name Shuangmiaosaurus refers to the village of Shuangmiao in Beipiao, Liaoning Province, where the fossils were found.
facts.quote: The generic name refers to the village of Shuangmiao in Beipiao in Liaoning Province, the site of the discovery

facts.statement: The species name gilmorei honors the American paleontologist Charles Whitney Gilmore.
facts.quote: The specific name honours the American paleontologist Charles Whitney Gilmore

facts.statement: The holotype specimen LPM 0165 was discovered in the Sunjiawan Formation.
facts.quote: The holotype, specimen LPM 0165, was found in the Sunjiawan Formation

facts.statement: Shuangmiaosaurus was a large ornithopod estimated to reach 7.5 meters in length and weigh 2.5 tonnes.
facts.quote: It was a rather large ornithopod, estimated at 7.5 m in length and 2.5 t in body mass

facts.statement: Shuangmiaosaurus lived in China during the Late Cretaceous Period, approximately 100 million years ago.
facts.quote: which lived in China during the Late Cretaceous Period, about 100 million years ago

facts.statement: Shuangmiaosaurus was originally classified as a basal member of the Hadrosauroidea, closely related to Hadrosauridae.
facts.quote: Shuangmiaosaurus was originally considered a basal member of the Hadrosauroidea, one closely related to the Hadrosauridae

facts.statement: Some researchers, including David B. Norman, debate the classification, considering Shuangmiaosaurus a basal member of Iguanodontia outside the Hadrosauroidea.
facts.quote: Subsequent authors, including David B. Norman of Cambridge University, consider it a more basal member of the Iguanodontia outside of the Hadrosauroidea

facts.statement: Shuangmiaosaurus lived in Asia during the middle of the Cretaceous Period, in the Albian stage, about 100 million years ago.
facts.quote: que vivió a mediados del período Cretácico en el Albiense, hace aproximadamente entre 100 millones de años en lo que es hoy Asia

facts.statement: Current research suggests the Sunjiawan Formation, where the fossils were found, is older than previously thought.
facts.quote: hoy se considera que era algo más antigua

facts.statement: Although Shuangmiaosaurus shares a specific suture type between the maxilla and jugal with Hadrosauridea, it lacks many characteristics defining that family.
facts.quote: Si bien comparte con Hadrosauridea el tipo de sutura entre el maxilar y el yugal, no posee muchas de las particularidades que caracteriza a esta Familia

facts.statement: The time range for Shuangmiaosaurus is estimated between 106.3 and 100.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Albian to Albian (106.3 to 100.5 million years ago)

facts.statement: The Paleobiology Database lists Hadrosauroidea as the parent group for Shuangmiaosaurus.
